arguments.sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNL" l GROUP BY l."JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT"))>0.001
SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL
SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", j."POST_DT", j."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" j ON j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE i."INV_AMT"<0 OR i."INV_ID"=802
SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM("INV_NO"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, ARRAY_AGG("INV_ID") AS ids FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING SUM(p."PAY_AMT")<>i."INV_AMT"
SELECT j."JRNL_NO", j."PRD_ID", j."POST_DT", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" j JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=j."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND j."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT" LIMIT 50
